'''Burr El''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he slew several innocent patrons in ''[[The Lucky Star]]'' in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and as a result became one of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild's]] top ten most wanted fugitives. An unknown [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] tracked him down and killed him.
